description: Implementation of the GroupDao interface, providing database access methods for Group entities, including retrieving groups by permissions, IDs, and group type.

classes.name: GroupDaoImpl
classes.description: Repository class implementing data access for Group entities, extending a generic DAO class and implementing custom query methods.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Fetches a list of Group entities associated with specified permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves groups by a set of group IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Returns a list of groups filtered by the specified GroupType.
